note: Manually coordinated MOTIF-inspired hypothesis receipt; NOT a native MOTIF run, graph admission, trained-model result, or verified intervention.
question: What explains rapid loss of foundational Static Collective project context between chats or within hours, and which intervention can measurably improve re-entry?
consequential_goal: Recover latest project truth and explicit corrections without burdening the human with historical reconstruction or promoting proposals into deployed facts.

observed_sources.scope: MOTIF reasoning spine and source/test boundaries

claims.text: Existing witness notes explicitly warn that external persistence is not automatic retrieval.
Public atlas cut contained 92 public repos, 3127 branch refs, 1739 open PRs; proposed code is abundant and can be confused with accepted implementation.
HUMKIN PR #166 was open and PR #165 merged when checked; these do not establish live behavior.
Missing fresh-chat retrieval is the dominant cause of reported continuity failures.
Source freshness and status misclassification are dominant: agents cite stale summaries or treat open PRs as deployed.
Important human corrections and foundational decisions never reach a durable project-owned carrier.
A recent model or product update independently reduced re-entry fidelity.
claims.scope: No controlled before/after data; don't attribute causality

claims.text: Any adequate remedy must independently test persistence, retrieval, state reconciliation, and correction retention. Saving more pages alone cannot guarantee re-entry.
claims.scope: Reasoned design conclusion, not measured intervention

counterexamples: An assistant that can retrieve an old status page but not check the PR state will still drift.
An assistant with fresh GitHub status but no recorded human constraint can still violate the foundational design.
A fresh chat that uses a supplied link is not an unbiased test of whether discovery works independently.
Two repeated wiki summaries copying one same repo are not independent evidence.
An open pull request, test fixture, successful merge, and field test are four different observations.
unresolved_conditions: Unknown frequency and causal breakdown of reported drift; no platform-internals access.
No native MOTIF solver run on this case; no matched classical-control outcome.
Need owner-approved policy for private/public project metadata and action triggers.
Need blind multi-chat replication and time-bounded source checks before declaring solution.

authorization.scope: Prototype receipts and read-only evaluation; no automatic merge, public disclosure of private state, or memory-ledger admission.

next_voluntary_probe.question: In a fresh, unbriefed chat, can the proposed source-link and status packet recover three projects' last verified state, latest correction, held PRs and next lawful move after a same-day PR change?
next_voluntary_probe.expected_decision_change: If retrieval, state accuracy, and correction retention succeed across pilot projects, consider adopting a project-owner approved minimal handoff contract; otherwise revise the trigger or source layout.
next_voluntary_probe.budget: Pilot 3 projects; 2 cuts/project; compare against normal chat-reentry baseline with same question and access, blinded to expected facts.
next_voluntary_probe.stop_condition: HOLD if a private source would be exposed, project status cannot be independently verified, or the agent fabricates a field test.

return_condition: Reinspect exact source state and live PR metadata before reuse. New evidence creates a descendant receipt, never edits the historical outcome.
